D: Five prank-loving Vermont state troopers try to save their station from budget cuts and the local police.
P: Serve the sweets when the maple syrup chugging starts.
S: Aged cheddar, thin apple and maple butter on toasted sourdough

Sourdough toasties of sharp aged cheddar and thin crisp apple, brushed with maple butter and grilled until golden, with a sharp wholegrain mustard. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 tbsp maple syrup. Core 2 crisp apples and slice very thin. Fill 8 slices of sourdough with 250g sliced aged cheddar and the apple, spreading a little wholegrain mustard inside. Brush the outsides with the maple butter. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut into triangles.
Crisp fries under cheddar sauce, bacon, pickled jalapeño, sour cream

Crunchy oven fries smothered in hot cheddar sauce, crispy bacon, pickled jalapeños and spring onion, with sour cream on the side. Bake 1kg frozen thick-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in 150g grated cheddar until smooth. Pile the fries on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and top with bacon, sliced pickled jalapeños and spring onion. Serve with 150g sour cream.
M: Two smashed beef patties, bacon and cheddar in a toasted bun

Two smashed beef patties with cheddar and crispy bacon in a toasted bun with burger sauce, pickles and onion, served with a stack of napkins. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls and smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top each with cheddar and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Toast 4 burger buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties, bacon, pickles and diced onion in each.
Rabbit's first week chicken pot pie
Rabbit's a rookie, so Rabbit brings dinner

Chicken, carrot, peas and thyme in a creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid, with buttered green beans. Brown the chicken in half the butter, add the onion and carrot and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and thyme, simmer until thick, then add the peas. Heat the oven to 200°C. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with pastry and brush with egg. Bake until golden. Boil the beans and toss with the rest of the butter.
W: Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon, whipped butter and maple syrup

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked with crispy bacon and whipped butter, drowned in warm maple syrup for pouring, not chugging. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 40g melted butter into a thick batter. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Cook ladles of batter in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden and risen. Beat 80g soft butter until fluffy. Stack 3 pancakes per plate with bacon and a spoon of butter, and pour over warm maple syrup (200ml total).
K: Citrus and spice cola syrup topped with soda water over ice

A homemade cola syrup of citrus, cinnamon, vanilla and caramelised sugar, topped with soda water and served by the litre jug over ice with lime. Put the zest of 1 orange, 1 lime and 1 lemon in a saucepan with 1 cinnamon stick, half a tsp coriander seeds, 1 star anise and 250ml water. Simmer 10 minutes. Melt 200g sugar until dark amber, carefully pour in the spiced water and stir until smooth. Add 1 tsp vanilla and the juice of the lime. Strain and cool. Mix 150ml syrup with 850ml soda water in a 1 litre jug full of ice.
